snippet.title: Visit a Sick Friend! 🍎 Fruits of Jannah | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Oh no! My friend is sick in bed today... What can I do?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) taught us: visiting a sick friend is like picking fruit in the gardens of Paradise, until you come back!

So let's go! Make a get-well card, take some fruit, knock and say Assalamu alaikum, sit with your friend, smile, and make a prayer: may Allah make you better! Who can you visit or call this week? Tell your grown-up!

Source
• Sahih Muslim 2568 (narrated by Hazrat Thawban, Radi Allahu Anhu): https://sunnah.com/muslim:2568c

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: DesignwithRiyas on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-112361/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only an ordinary family is drawn.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
